title: Steampunk Vortex Portal
description: A intricate steampunk machine with gears and a glowing blue eye hovers at the center of a massive swirling vortex of fire and red energy. The scene is set in a dark alien landscape with rocky formations, multiple floating colorful orbs, strange mechanical eyes on the ground, and smaller spacecraft drifting in the purple sky.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal painting of a complex brass steampunk orb with gears and a glowing blue central eye floating at the center of a massive swirling fiery red and orange energy vortex. The vortex is surrounded by floating colorful crystal orbs, small spacecraft, and mechanical eye-like structures on a dark rocky alien landscape under a purple twilight sky with dramatic red atmospheric glow.
